headline: Northwest Nazarene beat Seattle Pacific in conference opener
dek: Seattle Pacific arrived at Northwest Nazarene with seven wins, more than any other programme in the conference, and left with their second defeat of the season. Western Washington won at Saint Martin's, and Simon Fraser's visit to Western Oregon ended the way most of their matches have, in a draw.
displaced_by: Conference play opened and Seattle Pacific, the side with the most wins, lost the opener at Northwest Nazarene.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's 23 goals are more than Northwest Nazarene and Simon Fraser have scored together.

wire.line: Simon Fraser's conference opener at Western Oregon was their fourth draw, against one win and two defeats.
